title: Arrays
summary: Arrays store multiple values in a single ordered structure. They allow indexing, iteration, and efficient data organization. Arrays are useful when you need to group similar items together.

title: Objects
summary: Objects store data in key-value pairs, making them ideal for representing complex structures. They help group related properties and behaviors into a single unit.

How do you create and access properties in an object?
When would you prefer objects over arrays?

title: Events
summary: Events represent actions or occurrences like clicks, key presses, or messages. They allow programs to respond dynamically, enabling interactive behavior in applications.
sample_questions: How do events enable user interaction?

title: Error Handling
summary: Error handling ensures a program continues running smoothly even when unexpected issues occur. Using try-catch blocks helps manage and recover from errors gracefully.
